title: Live XYZ Unveils Report Showing Midtown South Corridor 42BELOW Retail Occupancy Growing 65% Faster Than Manhattan Overall
author: Live Xyz
description: The 42BELOW corridor in Midtown South Manhattan is experiencing a significant retail leasing surge with occupancy growing 65% faster than Manhattan overall. Storefront vacancy has dropped 19% over two years, with restaurants leading growth at 71 new openings. The area is transforming from an office-centric zone into a vibrant mixed-use district with emerging residential development, supported by major openings from brands like Fauchon, Life Time, and Aldi.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Signed 52,000-square-foot, four-level lease at 10 Bryant Park with opening planned for early 2027, demonstrating major investment and confidence in the area's residential and mixed-use growth.

title: Lithium Ionic Executes Definitive Agreement for US$20 Million Royalty Financing with Appian Capital
author: Lithium Ionic Corp.
description: TORONTO, June  28, 2024  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Lithium Ionic Corp. (TSXV: LTH; OTCQX: LTHCF; FSE: H3N) (“Lithium Ionic” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Lithium Ionic Bandeira Corp. (the “Grantor”), has executed a definitive royalty agreement (the “Royalty Agreement”) with ANRF LI (JSY) Ltd., an affiliate of Appian Capital Advisory LLP (“Appian”), granting a 2.25% gross revenue royalty in exchange for upfront cash consideration of US$20,000,000 (the “Royalty”). This agreement is substantially in line with the terms previously disclosed in the Company’s May 30, 2024, news release. Appian is an investment advisor to long-term, value-focused private capital funds that invest solely in mining and mining-related companies.

title: Lithium Ionic Completes Acquisition of Remaining 15% of Salinas Properties, Minas Gerais, Brazil
author: Lithium Ionic Corp.
description: TORONTO, June  11, 2024  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Lithium Ionic Corp. (TSXV: LTH; OTCQX: LTHCF; FSE: H3N) (“Lithium Ionic” or the “Company”) reports that, further to its May 30, 2024 press release, its wholly owned subsidiary, Neolit Minerals Participações Ltda (“Neolit”), has completed the acquisition of the remaining 15% of select Salinas properties (“Salinas” or the “Project”), located within the Curralinho Pegmatite Field of the lithium-rich Araçuaí Pegmatite District, in Minas Gerais, Brazil (the “Transaction”). Lithium Ionic now owns 100% of the Salinas group of properties (See Figure 1).
